Counsel for Petitioner :- Maimoona Fatima,Mohd Nasir Counsel for Respondent :- A.S.G.I.,Mukteshwar Upadhyay Hon'ble Salil Kumar Rai,J.
Hon'ble Surendra Singh-I,J.
Heard the counsel for the petitioner and Sri Mukteshwar Upadhyay, the counsel for the respondents.

The present petition has been filed praying for the following relief : -
"I. Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding to direct the Respondent No. 2 to decide the application of the Petitioner within stipulated time, and to issue the passport of the petitioner."

It appears from the records annexed with the writ petition that no orders are being passed on the Komal Kumar vs Union Of India And Another on 16 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/22317656/
1 application of the petitioner for the passport bearing File No. LKA077091778222 because of the pendency of Case Crime No. 504 of 2022 under Sections 379, 507, 506, 504, 420 and 406 of the Indian Penal Code.

entities.text: Komal Kumar vs Union Of India And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of the aforesaid, there is no illegality in the act of the passport department in not issuing the passport of the petitioner under clause (f) of sub-section (2) of Section 6 of the Passports Act, 1967.

However, in view of the office memorandum dated 10th October, 2019, No.VI/401/1/5/2019 which provides that the persons against whom criminal cases are pending may be exempted from the operation of Section 6 (2) (f) of the Act, 1967, in case, they produce orders from the court concerned permitting them to depart from India subject to the conditions enumerated in GSR 570 (E) dated 25.08.1993.

The petitioner may take steps for issuance of his passport in accordance with the conditions prescribed in the office memorandum dated 10th October, 2019 and in case, the petitioner fulfills the requirement prescribed in the said office memorandum, the concerned authority shall consider the case of the petitioner for issuance of his passport.
With the aforesaid observation, the writ petition is disposed of.
